intro: Gnoll Paws are crude physical trophies harvested from Riverpaw gnolls roaming the grasslands of Westfall. Collected by The People's Militia, they serve as proof of a patrol's success in thinning the packs that threaten the local farmsteads.

p: With the royal army absent and the crown seemingly blind to the plight of rural settlements, the defense of Westfall has fallen to ordinary citizens and volunteer forces. The People's Militia, operating out of Sentinel Hill, struggles constantly against outlaws, rogue mechanoids, and aggressive hyena-headed gnolls. To curb the gnoll menace, Captain Danuvin instituted bounties requiring physical evidence of slain beasts. Collecting severed paws is a grim necessity, ensuring that contracted adventurers truly scour the scrublands rather than loaf in the shadow of the watchtower.
